map.采样多少只工蜂比较准？: How many worker bees should be sampled for accuracy?
map.常用 200~300 只工蜂，样本越大估算越稳定。建议多点取样（子脾边角与外勤蜂: Typically 200~300 worker bees, and the larger the sample the more stable the estimate. Sample at multiple points (edges of brood frames and foragers) to avoid letting a single location represent the whole colony.
map.寄生率多少需要治螨？: At what infestation rate does mite treatment become necessary?
map.成年蜂寄生率一般超过 2%~3%，或巢房检出率明显上升时即需安排防治；还需结合群: For colonies, treatment is needed once infestation generally exceeds 2%~3% or brood detection rises markedly; also weigh colony strength, nectar flow and capping status, and avoid medication during the flow that would contaminate honey.
map.检测时要注意什么？: What should be watched out for when testing?
map.不同方法（糖粉、酒精、CO₂ 麻醉）测得的效率不同，应固定同一方法做纵向对比；检: Different methods (powdered sugar, alcohol, CO₂ anaesthesia) give different efficiencies, so fix one method for longitudinal comparison; return the bees promptly after testing and avoid working in cold periods that would damage the colony.
